title: FY27 Airfield Striping and Rubber Removal
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > 436 CONS LGCA

files.name: Sources Sought FY27 RR AND AIRFIELD STRIPING.pdf

description: This project is designed to remove excessive rubber build-up and refresh airfield markings ensuring all designs and construction comply with the most stringent codes and regulations. Will consist of providing all labor, materials, equipment, tools, appliances, and materials necessary to remove paint and rubber and to stripe airfield.
